w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
A stranger at the tree line, watching. Not hiding, exactly. Measuring. They'll be gone by dusk — but they'll remember what they saw.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/12/5), with 7 wave-4 fought, 4 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 12 · Craft 9 · Talk 10 · Explore 31 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Dakota Prince ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
